campaigns.name: Night of the Zealot
campaigns.note: The introductory campaign. Ghouls and cultists, with a doom clock that punishes slow play.

campaigns.name: The Dunwich Legacy
campaigns.note: Lots of enemies and a few huge, hard-to-damage monsters late on. Plenty of actions and ways to avoid fights pay off.

campaigns.name: The Path to Carcosa
campaigns.note: Heavy on horror and willpower. Sanity tends to run out before health does.

campaigns.name: The Forgotten Age
campaigns.note: Jungle exploration with poison, supplies and vengeance. Healing is scarce, so soak and avoiding damage matter.

campaigns.name: The Circle Undone
campaigns.note: Spectral and haunted threats with lots of willpower tests. Weak-willed decks struggle.

campaigns.name: The Dream-Eaters
campaigns.note: A split campaign: two groups play different scenarios. Expect some very large enemies in the Dreamlands.

campaigns.name: The Innsmouth Conspiracy
campaigns.note: Flooded locations, Deep Ones and key tokens. Mobility and agility come in handy.

campaigns.name: Edge of the Earth
campaigns.note: Frost tokens in the chaos bag and expedition partners you can bring along as allies.

campaigns.name: The Scarlet Keys
campaigns.note: A globe-trotting campaign where you choose where to travel; scenarios are varied and often short.

campaigns.name: The Feast of Hemlock Vale
campaigns.note: A day-and-night campaign around a village, with residents you build relationships with.
